mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult traveler with at least three facial or accessory anchors, one front-facing phone distance and one repeatable address-to-camera behavior. Rotate through at least three location chapters; in each chapter vary weather, outerwear and one local tactile interaction as a coordinated set while preserving identity anchors. Verify every chapter with both one specific environment landmark class and one human-scale object or food interaction. Hide major swaps inside a brief lens occlusion, matched hand gesture or color field, then resume the same face scale and behavior immediately. End after the third verified chapter with the same adult covering or lowering the phone. The reusable mechanism is identity lock, phone-vlog grammar, grouped environment/wardrobe variables, dual location verification, occlusion transitions and same-narrator closure—not the source woman, face, hair, coats, scarves, foods, London, Paris, Moscow, landmarks, weather, exact reactions, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one adult identity with three anchors, stable phone distance and repeatable camera-address behavior.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the narrator coherent across aggressive location swaps.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing face scale and anchors makes a new person plausible.

invariants.rule: Use at least three chapters and vary weather, outerwear and one tactile interaction as a coordinated set.
invariants.purpose: Makes every location a complete lived state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing only backgrounds produces a slideshow.

invariants.rule: Verify each chapter with one landmark class and one human-scale object interaction.
invariants.purpose: Balances world recognition with embodied presence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A landmark-only montage feels detached from the traveler.

invariants.rule: Hide major swaps inside one brief occlusion or matched gesture and resume the same face scale.
invariants.purpose: Makes discontinuity feel intentional while protecting identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Open cuts expose wardrobe and facial drift.

invariants.rule: Close from the same narrator position after the final verified chapter.
invariants.purpose: Returns the carousel to personal authorship.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on an anonymous landmark loses the traveler.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult woman, face, hair, makeup, earrings and exact expressions
the source olive, beige and cream coats, scarves, gloves, umbrella and outfits
the source fries, crepe, pastries, packaging, vendors and exact eating gestures
the source London, Paris and Moscow streets, landmarks, rain, night lights and snow
the source phone camera moves, transitions, creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording and 29-second timing
